## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the user-visible change and link its issue/spec where applicable.

## Validation

Commands actually run, results, platform coverage and remaining gaps.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Focused scope and atomic Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Tests cover behavior and failure paths; make check passes.
- [ ] Specs/contracts and progress evidence match implementation.
- [ ] Git, jj and GitButler identities/effects remain distinct; no silent write fallback.
- [ ] No unauthorized publication, data loss, hook bypass or worktree ownership changes.
